item.title: [IGNITE-2119] Tasks can get stuck in case of communication error
item.description:

Is this error expected and can it be caused by a random network error? If so, the future should be cancelled so that the tasks will be released (even with an exception).
Full stack traces of the process is attached.

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment:
Possibly sockCh.read() returned 0, and after flip() buf.hasRemaining() returned false.

Now method will exit if sockCh.read() returns 0.
